g.title: Public routes: server.ts:606-607. Separate from authenticated requests.
Protected routes: server.ts:356-359; lib/insecurity.ts:52. Badge covers the protected-route subset.
Password login: routes/login.ts:18.
Second-factor verification: routes/2fa.ts:16; server.ts:458. Temporary token and TOTP code in request body.
Management operations require JWT middleware: server.ts:465-473. Handler-specific password/TOTP checks still apply.
frontend/src/app/Services/request.interceptor.ts:13; server.ts:356. JWT-authenticated REST subset; WebSocket split out.
frontend/src/app/Services/socket-io.service.ts:23; lib/startup/registerWebsocketEvents.ts:20-57. Corrected endpoint from backend to realtime-channel.
frontend/src/app/Services/keys.service.ts:15-68; server.ts:641-645. No mandatory user session on these routes.
routes/showProductReviews.ts:36; routes/trackOrder.ts:18; data/mongodb.ts:9. Embedded collection calls, no DB login.
routes/nftMint.ts:18; routes/web3Wallet.ts:20. WebSocket provider URL carries configured ALCHEMY_API_KEY.
